deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep org.clojure/clojure, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package. (sha256 refreshed 2026-10-27: the monorepo deps sync changed the bytes; recorded digest is now this tree.)

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

test/kotoba/verifier_signing_cross_host_.reason: The suite opens fixture files by a path relative to the old repository root (test/...). The library suites run from the root of this repository, so each such path names the file where it now lives (lib/kotoba.kotobaVerifier/test/...). Nothing else in the file changes.

src/kotoba/verifier/native_signing.kotob.reason: Add canonical Kotoba adapter for the existing base64 X.509 SPKI and signature wire format to Amu selfhost Ed25519 verification. This keeps DER parsing and canonical base64 validation in Kotoba source without a JVM or Node crypto runtime.

test/native/signing_wire_probe.kotoba.reason: Add a fixed-vector native selfhost probe for the canonical Ed25519 wire adapter, including positive and refusal cases.

bin/check-native-signing-selfhost.reason: Add a reproducible KSL2 Amu selfhost check/compile/direct-run/artifact-run gate for the signing wire probe; the oracle is a fixed fixture, not a runtime dependency.

src/kotoba/verifier/artifact_envelope.ko.reason: Add native validation for exact cap-call/typed-cap-call arity and bounded capability IDs, generic typed request/result pairs, and exact clock/dataspace/UI provider contracts. Add iterative KExe body resource admission (depth 256, conservative 50,000-node cap, 65,536-byte strings/keywords) and independent core arithmetic/comparison/bool-not arity checks before capability/effect traversal. String and core-arity probes pass; exact deep/node boundaries and full verifier parity remain open.

test/native/artifact_envelope_probe.koto.reason: Add positive/refusal cases for KExe envelope shape, effects, code bytes, oracle markers, canonical seal tampering and KIR digest mismatch. Multi-module Amu library integration and full runtime verification remain unqualified.

test/native/compatibility_probe.kotoba.reason: Add an Amu native positive/refusal-free conformance probe for compatibility constants and all supported tender-contract mappings, including linux prelude precedence and unsupported fallback.

test/native/kexe_compatibility_probe.kot.reason: Probe verifier-side descriptor derivation and refusal for target/profile, exact map, HIR, ABI, tender contract, and f32/f64/mixed KIR-derived value ABIs.

test/native/float_usage_probe.kotoba.reason: Probe Kotoba f32/f64 usage derivation from parameter/result types and nested KIR operation forms, including mixed-width and non-float controls.

test/native/module_outline_probe.kotoba.reason: Add native positive/refusal coverage for generic typed capability calls, wrong provider type pair, malformed typed-call arity, and non-integer capability IDs alongside existing effect-body propagation cases.

test/native/resource_bounds_probe.kotoba.reason: Add locked Amu selfhost positive/refusal coverage for exact/over-limit body string bytes and core arithmetic/comparison/bool-not arities through standalone predicates and integrated function-effects matching. Dynamically generated node/depth boundaries trap with exit 133 and remain unqualified.
